dialogues.jp: その日、月城邸にみんなが集まった。
dialogues.en: Everyone gathered at the Tsukishiro Mansion.
dialogues.text: Everyone gathered at the Tsukishiro Mansion.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「皆様、今日はようこそいらっしゃいました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much for coming, everyone."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much for coming, everyone."

dialogues.jp:
背の高い瀬場さんが、まるでディナーショーの
司会のように、丁寧に挨拶をする。
dialogues.en:
The tall Seiba-san, very much fitting the role of the
chairman of a dinner party, politely welcomed us.
dialogues.text:
The tall Seiba-san, very much fitting the role of the
chairman of a dinner party, politely welcomed us.

dialogues.jp:
にっこりと笑った笑顔からは、この状況をとて
も喜び、楽しんでいるのだということが窺えた。
dialogues.en:
With smiles all around filled with happiness, and such a
joyful environment, this party was definitely going to be
fun.
dialogues.text:
With smiles all around filled with happiness, and such a
joyful environment, this party was definitely going to be
fun.

dialogues.speaker: suginami
dialogues.jp:
「セバスチャン、今日はお招きいただき、誠に
　ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en:
"Sebastian, you have my heartfelt thanks for the invite for
today."
dialogues.text:
"Sebastian, you have my heartfelt thanks for the invite for
today."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「今日も、美春はバナナのお菓子を作ってきま
　した！　いつもクッキーではつまらないので
　今日はバナナパイです！」
dialogues.en:
"I made another banana treat today! I thought cookies all
the time would be boring, so it's banana pie this time!"
dialogues.text:
"I made another banana treat today! I thought cookies all
the time would be boring, so it's banana pie this time!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あの……あたしまで来てよかったのかわから
　ないんだけど……、お招きありがとうござい
　ます」
dialogues.en:
"Um... I'm not sure whether I'm should really be here... but
thank you for the invitation."
dialogues.text:
"Um... I'm not sure whether I'm should really be here... but
thank you for the invitation."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「なんだか、その……こういうとこには慣れて
　ないから、ちょっと照れくさい……かな」
dialogues.en: "It feels a bit embarassing... not really used to it..."
dialogues.text: "It feels a bit embarassing... not really used to it..."

dialogues.jp:
眞子が髪の毛の先をいじりながら、目を泳がせ
る。こういう時は、意外と取り乱すもんなんだ
な。ちょっと面白い。
dialogues.en:
Mako rubbed her hair nervously, her eyes dancing around all
over the place. It's funny to see her so flustered, for
once.
dialogues.text:
Mako rubbed her hair nervously, her eyes dancing around all
over the place. It's funny to see her so flustered, for
once.

dialogues.jp: 「俺も、お招きありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, thanks for the inivitation."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, thanks for the inivitation."

dialogues.jp:
月城と一緒に招待状を書いた身としては、こう
いう時のコメントに困る。
dialogues.en:
I made those invitations with Tsukishiro though, so maybe I
shouldn't have said that...
dialogues.text:
I made those invitations with Tsukishiro though, so maybe I
shouldn't have said that...

dialogues.jp:
それぞれが挨拶をすると、奥にいた月城がぺこ
りと頭をさげた。
dialogues.en:
In the middle of all the thanks and salutations flying
around, Alice bowed politely to all of us.
dialogues.text:
In the middle of all the thanks and salutations flying
around, Alice bowed politely to all of us.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……今日は、皆さん、遊びに来てくれて、あ
　りがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you very much, everyone, for coming today."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you very much, everyone, for coming today."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……先日は、私のために色々よくしていただ
　いて、ありがとうございました」
dialogues.en:
"...And thank you, for all your help that day, in making me
become what I am."
dialogues.text:
"...And thank you, for all your help that day, in making me
become what I am."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……えと、あの……今日は、その、心ばかり
　ではありますが、楽しんでいってください」
dialogues.en:
"...Erm, and... I hope today will be enjoyable for
everyone."
dialogues.text:
"...Erm, and... I hope today will be enjoyable for
everyone."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、もう１度ぺこりとお辞儀をした。
dialogues.en: As she finished spoking, another polite bow.
dialogues.text: As she finished spoking, another polite bow.

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上には、瀬場さんの手作りらしいお
菓子や料理がたくさん並んでいた。
dialogues.en:
The table was filled with delicious-looking sweets and
snacks, lined up row-by-row.
dialogues.text:
The table was filled with delicious-looking sweets and
snacks, lined up row-by-row.

dialogues.jp:
めいめいが席に着くと、瀬場さんが紅茶をカッ
プに注いでくれた。シャープだけれど、フルー
ティな香りが部屋に広がった。
dialogues.en:
As we started to take our seats, Seiba-san began pouring tea
into our cups. It had a sharp, yet fruity smell.
dialogues.text:
As we started to take our seats, Seiba-san began pouring tea
into our cups. It had a sharp, yet fruity smell.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さん……、もう全然お喋りしても平気み
　たいだね」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro-san... you seem perfectly fine with talking
now!"
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro-san... you seem perfectly fine with talking
now!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……はい、皆さんのおかげです」
dialogues.en: "...Yes, because of everyone's support."
dialogues.text: "...Yes, because of everyone's support."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あの……それでね、今日は月城さんにプレゼ
　ントを持って来たんです」
dialogues.en:
"And, well... because of that... I brought a present for you
today."
dialogues.text:
"And, well... because of that... I brought a present for you
today."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……プレゼント？」
dialogues.en: "...A present?"
dialogues.text: "...A present?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「これ、なんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "It's not much, but..."
dialogues.text: "It's not much, but..."

dialogues.jp:
美春ががさがさと紙袋から取り出したものは
……。
dialogues.en: Miharu rustled through her bag, eventually pulling out...
dialogues.text: Miharu rustled through her bag, eventually pulling out...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……それは、ピロス」
dialogues.en: "...That's... Piros..."
dialogues.text: "...That's... Piros..."

dialogues.jp:
美春が手に持っていたものは、月城の大切にし
ていた、あの人形だった。
dialogues.en: Miharu was holding that doll, so special to Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text: Miharu was holding that doll, so special to Tsukishiro.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「うん、実は、先日ここへ来た時に、瀬場さん
　から預からせてもらったの」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. I've actually had him for some time, I asked
Seiba-san whether I could take him for awhile..."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. I've actually had him for some time, I asked
Seiba-san whether I could take him for awhile..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん、美春なら、直せると思って」
dialogues.en: "I thought that I might be able to fix it."
dialogues.text: "I thought that I might be able to fix it."

dialogues.jp:
人形は、多少継ぎができていたが、元通り可愛
らしい姿に戻っていた。
dialogues.en:
The doll, excepting a few patches here and there, had
returned to the cute figure it once was.
dialogues.text:
The doll, excepting a few patches here and there, had
returned to the cute figure it once was.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「もうちょっと、綺麗に直せたらよかったんだ
　けどね」
dialogues.en: "I wish I could've done it a little better though..."
dialogues.text: "I wish I could've done it a little better though..."

dialogues.jp: 美春が、照れ笑いをしながら、人形を渡す。
dialogues.en:
Miharu blushingly giggled to herself, while handing over the
doll.
dialogues.text:
Miharu blushingly giggled to herself, while handing over the
doll.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ううん！　ありがとう……！　本当に……あ
　りがとう！」
dialogues.en: "No! Thank you...! Thank you so much...!"
dialogues.text: "No! Thank you...! Thank you so much...!"

dialogues.jp: 人形をぎゅっと抱きしめる月城。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro entwined her arms around the doll, holding it
tightly to her chest.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro entwined her arms around the doll, holding it
tightly to her chest.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ピロス。……ピロス」
dialogues.en: "...Piros... Piros."
dialogues.text: "...Piros... Piros."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そんなに喜んでもらえると、頑張って直した
　甲斐がありました」
dialogues.en:
"Seeing you so happy really makes the effort all
worthwhile!"
dialogues.text:
"Seeing you so happy really makes the effort all
worthwhile!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ありがとう、天枷さん。……ピロスを直して
　くれてありがとう」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you, Amakase-san... thank you so much for fixing
Piros."
dialogues.text:
"Thank you, Amakase-san... thank you so much for fixing
Piros."

dialogues.jp:
まさか、あの壊れた人形を美春が直していたな
んてな。
dialogues.en: ...Miharu was fixing up that doll this entire time?
dialogues.text: ...Miharu was fixing up that doll this entire time?

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんも美春も人が悪い。俺にはそんなこと
ちっとも教えてくれないんだから。
dialogues.en: Damnit, Seiba-san, Miharu... you could've at least told me!
dialogues.text: Damnit, Seiba-san, Miharu... you could've at least told me!

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さて、次は俺の番だな……」
dialogues.en: "Looks like it's my turn now..."
dialogues.text: "Looks like it's my turn now..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前も、プレゼントを！？」
dialogues.en: "You have a present too!?"
dialogues.text: "You have a present too!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ、その意外そうな顔は。パーティーに
　呼ばれたんだ。プレゼントくらい当たり前だ
　ろうが」
dialogues.en:
"What's with that wary face! I was invited to a party, of
course I would have a present!"
dialogues.text:
"What's with that wary face! I was invited to a party, of
course I would have a present!"

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、そう言うと、いつにも増して得意そう
な顔で、荷物を取り出す。
dialogues.en:
With far more pride than neccessary, as usual, he produced a
luggage bag.
dialogues.text:
With far more pride than neccessary, as usual, he produced a
luggage bag.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうだッ！　ロシアの伝統工芸、マトリョー
　シカ！　この人形の中には、なんとまた人形
　が！　そしてその中には……」
dialogues.en:
"How's this! One of Russia's finest in theatre, the
Matrioska! Inside this doll, is yet another doll! And inside
that..."
dialogues.text:
"How's this! One of Russia's finest in theatre, the
Matrioska! Inside this doll, is yet another doll! And inside
that..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……また、そんなものを持ってきたのか！」
dialogues.en: "...You're still holding onto crap like that!?"
dialogues.text: "...You're still holding onto crap like that!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ピロスキーの代わりになればと思ったんだが」
dialogues.en: "I thought it would be an able replacement for Pirosuki."
dialogues.text: "I thought it would be an able replacement for Pirosuki."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……さすがに、それはちょっと」
dialogues.en: "...Right now, that's a little..."
dialogues.text: "...Right now, that's a little..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「一応、ブードゥーのまじない用の人形も持っ
　てきたんだが……、いるか？」
dialogues.en:
"It can also be used as a voodoo doll, depending on who you
want to target... is there someone like that?"
dialogues.text:
"It can also be used as a voodoo doll, depending on who you
want to target... is there someone like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「よしてくださいよ。そんな気味の悪いもの」
dialogues.en: "...That gives me a reaaaally bad feeling."
dialogues.text: "...That gives me a reaaaally bad feeling."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「結構高いんだがなぁ、コレ」
dialogues.en: "This was extremely expensive, after all."
dialogues.text: "This was extremely expensive, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「知るか！」
dialogues.en: "As if you would know!"
dialogues.text: "As if you would know!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……くすくす、ふふふ」
dialogues.en: "...Hehe, ahahaha."
dialogues.text: "...Hehe, ahahaha."

dialogues.jp: 月城が笑う。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro was laughing.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro was laughing.

dialogues.jp: あれから、月城はよく笑うようになった。
dialogues.en:
She was truly enjoying herself, laughing because she wanted
to.
dialogues.text:
She was truly enjoying herself, laughing because she wanted
to.

dialogues.jp:
コロコロと、こんなに明るい少女だったのかと
思うくらい可愛らしく笑っていた。
dialogues.en:
A pleasant-sounding and cute laugh, even more enhanced by
the bright girl it was coming from.
dialogues.text:
A pleasant-sounding and cute laugh, even more enhanced by
the bright girl it was coming from.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あたしも何か持ってきた方がいいかなぁって
　思ったんだけど、月城さんのこと、まだよく
　知らないから……」
dialogues.en:
"I thought it would be better if I didn't bring a present,
since I don't really much about you, Tsukishiro-san..."
dialogues.text:
"I thought it would be better if I didn't bring a present,
since I don't really much about you, Tsukishiro-san..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……いえ、そんな気を遣わないでください」
dialogues.en: "...No, you don't have to feel obligated at all."
dialogues.text: "...No, you don't have to feel obligated at all."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ううん、フルート持ってきたの。１曲演奏し
　ようかと思って」
dialogues.en:
"But, I still have my flute. I can give you a 1-song
performance."
dialogues.text:
"But, I still have my flute. I can give you a 1-song
performance."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……フルート？」
dialogues.en: "...Flute?"
dialogues.text: "...Flute?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「眞子先輩のフルートは、プロ並みなんですよ！
　こんなところで聞けるなんて、嬉しいです」
dialogues.en:
"Mako's flute-playing is as good as a professional's! To be
able to hear it here is a real treat!"
dialogues.text:
"Mako's flute-playing is as good as a professional's! To be
able to hear it here is a real treat!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「クラシックが好きって聞いてたから、ちょっ
　とやってみたんだけど、まだあたしには無理
　だったみたい」
dialogues.en:
"I have heard that you like classical music, but
unfortunately, that's a bit too much for me right now..."
dialogues.text:
"I have heard that you like classical music, but
unfortunately, that's a bit too much for me right now..."

dialogues.jp:
眞子は、そう言って俺達になじみのあるちょっ
と懐かしい歌謡曲を吹いてくれた。
dialogues.en:
Having said her piece, she put her mouth to her flute, and
proceeded to let her music do the talking, with a nostalgic,
intimate tune.
dialogues.text:
Having said her piece, she put her mouth to her flute, and
proceeded to let her music do the talking, with a nostalgic,
intimate tune.

dialogues.jp:
イヤミのひとつでも言ってやろうとか思ったけ
れど、眞子の演奏はとてもじゃないが、文句の
つけようがない。
dialogues.en:
I half-wanted to say something sarcastic, but listening to
her performance, I didn't even have a single complaint.
dialogues.text:
I half-wanted to say something sarcastic, but listening to
her performance, I didn't even have a single complaint.

dialogues.jp:
心地よい音色が、身体中を駆けめぐるような感
覚に包まれる。
dialogues.en:
The music was running through my body, giving me sensations
throughout.
dialogues.text:
The music was running through my body, giving me sensations
throughout.

dialogues.jp: ずっとこのまま音色を聞いていたいような……。
dialogues.en: I could listen to this forever...
dialogues.text: I could listen to this forever...

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「若い頃を思い出します……。壁に行き当たっ
　た時はいつもこの歌を聴いておりました」
dialogues.en:
"Such a gentle reminder of my youth. whenever I was
frustrated, I would listen to songs such as this to calm
myself."
dialogues.text:
"Such a gentle reminder of my youth. whenever I was
frustrated, I would listen to songs such as this to calm
myself."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんが、思わずハンカチで涙を拭う。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san was dabbing his eyes with his handkerchief.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san was dabbing his eyes with his handkerchief.

dialogues.jp: そして、演奏が終わり、部屋が静寂に包まれる。
dialogues.en:
Mako eventually finished her performance, and the room was
left in complete silence.
dialogues.text:
Mako eventually finished her performance, and the room was
left in complete silence.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……水越先輩、素敵です」
dialogues.en: "...Mizukoshi-senpai, that was fantastic."
dialogues.text: "...Mizukoshi-senpai, that was fantastic."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、素直に拍手をした。あの杉並でさえ、熱
心に手を叩いている。
dialogues.en:
I politely clapped my hands. Suginami next to me, showed
much more passion in his "applause".
dialogues.text:
I politely clapped my hands. Suginami next to me, showed
much more passion in his "applause".

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、照れちゃうね……」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha, this is kinda embarassing..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha, this is kinda embarassing..."

dialogues.jp:
眞子が嬉しいんだか照れくさいんだかわからな
いくらいに頬を赤らめて、ぺこぺことお辞儀を
する。
dialogues.en:
Mako's face was a mix of pleasure and embarassment. She
bowed several times at our appreciative applause.
dialogues.text:
Mako's face was a mix of pleasure and embarassment. She
bowed several times at our appreciative applause.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……水越先輩、素敵なプレゼント、ありがと
　うございました」
dialogues.en:
"...Mizukoshi-senpai, thank you very much for the wonderful
present."
dialogues.text:
"...Mizukoshi-senpai, thank you very much for the wonderful
present."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、つたない演奏で申し訳ないけど」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha, I should be apologizing for such a poor performance
instead..."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha, I should be apologizing for such a poor performance
instead..."

dialogues.speaker: seiba
dialogues.jp:
「何をおっしゃいます！　最高でしたぞ！　こ
　の瀬場、涙が止まりませぬ……！」
dialogues.en:
"Nonsense! That was of the highest quality! I cannot stop my
tears from falling...!"
dialogues.text:
"Nonsense! That was of the highest quality! I cannot stop my
tears from falling...!"

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんが涙をちょちょぎらせながら、眞子の
手をガッシと握る。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san held Mako's hand with both of his, waterfalls
pouring from his eyes.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san held Mako's hand with both of his, waterfalls
pouring from his eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、はぁ、あ、ありがとうござます……」
dialogues.en: "Eh, ah, um, t, thank you..."
dialogues.text: "Eh, ah, um, t, thank you..."

dialogues.jp: たじろぎながら、引きつり笑みを浮かべる眞子。
dialogues.en: Mako understandably got even more flustered.
dialogues.text: Mako understandably got even more flustered.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さて、次は……朝倉の番だが」
dialogues.en: "Now, next would be... Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Now, next would be... Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あ、俺は……その、えぇと……」

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もしかして……」
dialogues.en: "Don't tell me..."
dialogues.text: "Don't tell me..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「何も持ってきて……」
dialogues.en: "You didn't get..."
dialogues.text: "You didn't get..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ないとか……」
dialogues.en: "Anything..."
dialogues.text: "Anything..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Weeeelll..."
dialogues.text: "Weeeelll..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "That's..."
dialogues.text: "That's..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ははは、いやぁ、なに持ってきていいか、わ
　かんなくてさ。なにも、買ってない……てい
　うか買ってない」
dialogues.en:
"...Hahaha, I thought it'd be okay to come alone with
nothing. So I didn't buy anything at all, aha..."
dialogues.text:
"...Hahaha, I thought it'd be okay to come alone with
nothing. So I didn't buy anything at all, aha..."

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、ハハハと笑ってみる。
dialogues.en: I laughed out loudly, trying to hide my embarassment.
dialogues.text: I laughed out loudly, trying to hide my embarassment.

dialogues.jp:
笑ってみるが、それぞれの白い目が俺に向けら
れる。
dialogues.en:
Those bright white eyes of Tsukishiro's turned to my
desperately-laughing figure.
dialogues.text:
Those bright white eyes of Tsukishiro's turned to my
desperately-laughing figure.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「あの……先輩、気にしなくて、いいですから」
dialogues.en: "Um... Senpai, don't worry, it's fine."
dialogues.text: "Um... Senpai, don't worry, it's fine."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、あたふたしながらそう言った。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro quickly said to me, trying to keep me from
feeling bad.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro quickly said to me, trying to keep me from
feeling bad.

dialogues.jp: 優しいなぁ、月城は。
dialogues.en: She's so kind, that Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text: She's so kind, that Tsukishiro.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「まったく、なにも持ってこないなんて！」
dialogues.en: "You really didn't bring anything!"
dialogues.text: "You really didn't bring anything!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「サイテーだな」
dialogues.en: "The worst."
dialogues.text: "The worst."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「サイテーね」
dialogues.en: "Absolute worst."
dialogues.text: "Absolute worst."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「サイテー」
dialogues.en: "Completely the worst."
dialogues.text: "Completely the worst."

dialogues.speaker: Mako & Miharu
dialogues.en: "Yep!"
dialogues.text: "Yep!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako & Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「仕方ないだろ……。買ってないものは、買っ
　てないんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Geez, that's enough... I didn't buy anything, means I
dind't buy anything..."
dialogues.text:
"Geez, that's enough... I didn't buy anything, means I
dind't buy anything..."

dialogues.jp:
と言っても、周りの｛ぶべつ／侮蔑｝したような目が収まる
訳ではなかった。
dialogues.en:
The several pairs of withering eyes glaring at me seemed to
disagree.
dialogues.text:
The several pairs of withering eyes glaring at me seemed to
disagree.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「まあまあ、皆様。いいではありませんか。さ、
　おかわりもございますので、どうぞ、お召し
　上がりください」
dialogues.en:
"Now now, everybody. It's fine, is it not? Seconds are about
to be served, please dig in."
dialogues.text:
"Now now, everybody. It's fine, is it not? Seconds are about
to be served, please dig in."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんの言葉で、とりあえず、波風が収まる。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san's timely interevention managed to calm the storm.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san's timely interevention managed to calm the storm.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、瀬場さんの作ったお菓子や料理を楽し
みながら、時間は緩やかに過ぎていった。
dialogues.en:
Enjoying Seiba-san's tasty works of art, time passed by
quickly.
dialogues.text:
Enjoying Seiba-san's tasty works of art, time passed by
quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「──ところで月城さん」
dialogues.en: "--By the way, Tsukishiro-san?"
dialogues.text: "--By the way, Tsukishiro-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さんが、ロスキルラベンダーを育ててい
　た理由って、結局なんだったんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"What was your reason for trying to grow the Roskill
Lavender, in the end?"
dialogues.text:
"What was your reason for trying to grow the Roskill
Lavender, in the end?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そういえば、それは知りたいな」
dialogues.en: "Now that you say it, I want to know too."
dialogues.text: "Now that you say it, I want to know too."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「でも……、もう終わったことですから」
dialogues.en: "But... it's over and done with, now."
dialogues.text: "But... it's over and done with, now."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春達で、助けてあげられることかもしれな
　いじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "We might still be able to do something about it!"
dialogues.text: "We might still be able to do something about it!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「聞かせてくれ……。月城が、身体を張ってま
　であの花に願いを託していた訳を」
dialogues.en:
"Tell us... the wish that you entrusted to the flower, that
you risked life and limb for."
dialogues.text:
"Tell us... the wish that you entrusted to the flower, that
you risked life and limb for."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、紅茶をこくんと飲んで、喉を湿らせる。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro nodded, taking sips off her cup of red tea.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro nodded, taking sips off her cup of red tea.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「私は……、ロスキルラベンダーに、ひとつの
　願い事をしていました」
dialogues.en: "I... wished just one thing, of the Roskill Lavender."
dialogues.text: "I... wished just one thing, of the Roskill Lavender."

dialogues.jp: 静かにゆっくりと話し始める。
dialogues.en: She quietly, slowly began to tell her tale.
dialogues.text: She quietly, slowly began to tell her tale.

dialogues.jp: 自分でも、かみ砕き、そして｛えんか／嚥下｝しながら……。
dialogues.en: The wish that she wanted to protect with her own body...
dialogues.text: The wish that she wanted to protect with her own body...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「私は……、『お友達が欲しい』ただ、それだ
　けを願って、何年も何年も花が咲くように一
　生懸命育てていました」
dialogues.en:
"I wanted... to have friends, and that was my wish. I tried
year after year, to grow a flower, for that purpose."
dialogues.text:
"I wanted... to have friends, and that was my wish. I tried
year after year, to grow a flower, for that purpose."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「と、友達が欲しい！？」
dialogues.en: "W, wanted to have friends!?"
dialogues.text: "W, wanted to have friends!?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「はい、私は、ずーっとお友達がいませんでし
　た。ずーっとずっと寂しい想いばかりしてき
　ました……」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I always had no friends... always had feelings of
loneliness..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I always had no friends... always had feelings of
loneliness..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「お友達といえば、両親から与えられたピロス
　だけ。けれど、ピロスは自分で動けないし、
　喋ることもできない」
dialogues.en:
"The only friend I had, so to speak, was the doll that my
parents gave me, Piros. But Piros couldn't move, or talk by
itself.
dialogues.text:
"The only friend I had, so to speak, was the doll that my
parents gave me, Piros. But Piros couldn't move, or talk by
itself.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「両親が死んで……私はさらに独りぼっち。周
　りには誰もいないし、お友達の作り方だって
　わからない」
dialogues.en:
"When my parents died... I was completely alone. There was
no one else around me, and I didn't know how to make
friends."
dialogues.text:
"When my parents died... I was completely alone. There was
no one else around me, and I didn't know how to make
friends."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「だから、私は向こうで両親からもらったロス
　キルラベンダーに願うしかなかったんです」
dialogues.en:
"So, having heard of the Roskill Lavender from my parents, I
wanted to make a wish upon it."
dialogues.text:
"So, having heard of the Roskill Lavender from my parents, I
wanted to make a wish upon it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「お友達が欲しい。私にお友達をください。独
　りぼっちはもう嫌です──って」
dialogues.en:
"I wanted friends. "I want to have people to call friends. I
don't want to be alone"... was my wish, in full."
dialogues.text:
"I wanted friends. "I want to have people to call friends. I
don't want to be alone"... was my wish, in full."

dialogues.jp: 月城がピロスをきゅっと抱きかかえる。
dialogues.en: She hugged Piros tightly to her chest.
dialogues.text: She hugged Piros tightly to her chest.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「でも、今はもうロスキルラベンダーの種はな
　くなってしまった……」
dialogues.en:
"But, I no longer have any seeds to try to grow Roskill
Lavenders..."
dialogues.text:
"But, I no longer have any seeds to try to grow Roskill
Lavenders..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ただひとりのお友達、ピロスは帰ってきた
　けれど、もう私の願いを叶えるものはない
　の……」
dialogues.en:
"My only friend, Piros, may have returned, but that still
meant my wish would never be granted..."
dialogues.text:
"My only friend, Piros, may have returned, but that still
meant my wish would never be granted..."

dialogues.jp: 月城の目尻にはうっすらと涙が溜っていた。
dialogues.en: Tears started forming at the corners of her eyes.
dialogues.text: Tears started forming at the corners of her eyes.

dialogues.jp: それがいつしか溢れ、頬を伝って零れ落ちる。
dialogues.en:
They eventually fell, trailing down Tuskishiro's trembling
cheek.
dialogues.text:
They eventually fell, trailing down Tuskishiro's trembling
cheek.

dialogues.jp: 「ぷっ、くくく……あははは」
dialogues.en: "M, mmmmph.... ahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "M, mmmmph.... ahahaha..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、溜らず笑い出す。
dialogues.en: I couldn't control myself any longer.
dialogues.text: I couldn't control myself any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉先輩、笑うなんてひどい」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-senpai, that's mean."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-senpai, that's mean."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「悪ぃ、でも……くくく」
dialogues.en: "S, sorry, but... heheh..."
dialogues.text: "S, sorry, but... heheh..."

dialogues.jp:
一生懸命堪えるが、どうしても笑いが込み上げ
てくる。
dialogues.en:
Having held it in to hear out her entire story, it wasn't
going to stop so easily.
dialogues.text:
Having held it in to hear out her entire story, it wasn't
going to stop so easily.

dialogues.jp:
ふと見れば、美春や杉並、そして瀬場さんまで
もがクスクスと笑っていた。
dialogues.en:
Miharu, Suginami, even Seiba-san, were all stifling their
own laughter as well.
dialogues.text:
Miharu, Suginami, even Seiba-san, were all stifling their
own laughter as well.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……みなさん、瀬場さんまで！　ひどい」
dialogues.en: "...Everyone... even Seiba-san! That's mean!"
dialogues.text: "...Everyone... even Seiba-san! That's mean!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「月城の周り、見てみなよ」
dialogues.en: "Look around you."
dialogues.text: "Look around you."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「笑ってる皆さんがいるだけ……です」
dialogues.en: "I see everyone... laughing."
dialogues.text: "I see everyone... laughing."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「くくく、その周りの連中、なんだと思う？」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha... yes, and of those "everyone"... what do you think
of them?"
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha... yes, and of those "everyone"... what do you think
of them?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「…………どういうこと、ですか？」
dialogues.en: "...What might you mean?"
dialogues.text: "...What might you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「友達、だよ。みんな、月城の友達だよ。みん
　な月城のことを大切に思ってくれている友達
　だよ」
dialogues.en:
"They're friends. Everyone here is a friend of yours.
Everyone thinks Tsukishiro is an important friend of theirs,
too."
dialogues.text:
"They're friends. Everyone here is a friend of yours.
Everyone thinks Tsukishiro is an important friend of theirs,
too."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Fr...iends?"
dialogues.text: "...Fr...iends?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「月城は、今、独りぼっちか？　寂しいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you feel like you're alone now? Lonely, at all?"
dialogues.text: "Do you feel like you're alone now? Lonely, at all?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……今は、寂しくありません。天枷さんや杉
　並先輩や、水越先輩、……それに朝倉先輩が
　いるから」
dialogues.en:
"...No, I'm not. Not with Amakase-san, Suginami-senpai,
Mako-senpai... and Asakura-senpai around."
dialogues.text:
"...No, I'm not. Not with Amakase-san, Suginami-senpai,
Mako-senpai... and Asakura-senpai around."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「くく……、月城。月城の欲しかった『友達』
　というのは、今周りにいるみんなのことじゃ、
　ないのかい？」
dialogues.en:
"Haha... so, the "friends" you so desperately wished for...
aren't they all around you, right now?"
dialogues.text:
"Haha... so, the "friends" you so desperately wished for...
aren't they all around you, right now?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「──それとも、もっと違う『友達』なのかい」
dialogues.en: "--Is that any different from what you think friends are?"
dialogues.text: "--Is that any different from what you think friends are?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、必死で笑いを堪えながら、そう尋ねた。
dialogues.en: Finally calming down my laughter, I asked her.
dialogues.text: Finally calming down my laughter, I asked her.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は、月城さんの友達ですよ。美春は月城
　さんのことが大好きです」
dialogues.en: "I'm a friend of yours, definitely! I like you a lot!"
dialogues.text: "I'm a friend of yours, definitely! I like you a lot!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「私は、まだ月城さんのことをよく知らないけ
　れど友達になりたいって思うかな」
dialogues.en:
"I don't really know you that well, but... I think I'd like
to be your friend too."
dialogues.text:
"I don't really know you that well, but... I think I'd like
to be your friend too."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「たくさんの、いい友達がいるじゃないか。も
　ちろん、俺だって月城嬢の『友達』だと思っ
　てもらって構わないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You have several good friends are you. Of course, I
wouldn't mind being considered one of them."
dialogues.text:
"You have several good friends are you. Of course, I
wouldn't mind being considered one of them."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様、私だってお嬢様のことが大好き、で
　ございますよ」
dialogues.en: "Mistress, I do like you very much, as well."
dialogues.text: "Mistress, I do like you very much, as well."

dialogues.jp:
月城が、涙目のままきょとんとした表情で、辺
りを見回す。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, starting to cry for an entirely different reason
now, swiveled her head to look at all of us.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, starting to cry for an entirely different reason
now, swiveled her head to look at all of us.

dialogues.jp: 美春の顔、
dialogues.en: Miharu,
dialogues.text: Miharu,

dialogues.jp: 眞子の顔、
dialogues.en: Mako,
dialogues.text: Mako,

dialogues.jp: 杉並の顔、
dialogues.en: Suginami,
dialogues.text: Suginami,

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんの顔、
dialogues.en: Seiba-san,
dialogues.text: Seiba-san,

dialogues.jp: そして、俺の顔。
dialogues.en: And finally, myself.
dialogues.text: And finally, myself.

dialogues.jp:
「月城、君は寂しくなんかない。友達もこんな
　にいっぱいいる」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro, you won't be lonely anymore. Look at all the
friends you have."
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro, you won't be lonely anymore. Look at all the
friends you have."

dialogues.jp: 大きく頷く月城。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro nodded firmly.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro nodded firmly.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、友達だけではなく『恋人』もできたみ
　たいだがね」
dialogues.en: "Well, not only friends, but "lovers" too, it seems."
dialogues.text: "Well, not only friends, but "lovers" too, it seems."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「す、杉並ッ！」
dialogues.en: "S, Suginami!"
dialogues.text: "S, Suginami!"

dialogues.jp: ポ〜ッ、と顔を赤らめる月城がいた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro's cheeks instantly flushed red.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro's cheeks instantly flushed red.

dialogues.jp: そして、こくんと頷くと、
dialogues.en: But she still nodded, at his words.
dialogues.text: But she still nodded, at his words.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「私は……もう、寂しくありません」
dialogues.en: "I'm... not alone anymore."
dialogues.text: "I'm... not alone anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「お友達もピロスだけじゃありません。たくさ
　んのお友達が私にいます」
dialogues.en: "Piros isn't my only friend. I have so many friends now."
dialogues.text: "Piros isn't my only friend. I have so many friends now."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、もう泣いていなかった。涙の代わりに
たくさんの笑顔を湛えていた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro was no longer crying. Taking it's place was one
of her beautiful smiles.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro was no longer crying. Taking it's place was one
of her beautiful smiles.

dialogues.jp:
そして、そんな月城を、俺や、美春、眞子に杉
並、瀬場さんが嬉しそうに見ていた。
dialogues.en:
The beautiful smile, joyfully gazing at Seiba-san, Suginami,
Miharu, Mako, and I.
dialogues.text:
The beautiful smile, joyfully gazing at Seiba-san, Suginami,
Miharu, Mako, and I.

dialogues.jp:
お茶会は、つづがなく終わり、俺は帰る前に、
ちょっとだけ月城の部屋に寄った。
dialogues.en:
The tea party continued on till it's end, but before I left,
I went to Tsukishiro's room.
dialogues.text:
The tea party continued on till it's end, but before I left,
I went to Tsukishiro's room.

dialogues.jp:
他の連中は、ニヤニヤと笑ったが、なにも言わ
ずに俺の背中を押した。
dialogues.en:
The others were grinning, but I left what they were saying
behind me, and plodded ahead.
dialogues.text:
The others were grinning, but I left what they were saying
behind me, and plodded ahead.

dialogues.jp: 「月城……いや、アリス」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro... no, Alice."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro... no, Alice."

dialogues.jp:
名前で呼んだ月城は、ちょっとだけ緊張した面
持ちで俺を見た。
dialogues.en:
I called her by her given name for the first time. She
turned to face me, nervously.
dialogues.text:
I called her by her given name for the first time. She
turned to face me, nervously.

dialogues.jp:
「さっきは、プレゼントなんてないって言った
　けど、ホントはちゃんと買ってあるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I said a while ago that I didn't have a present for you...
but actually, I did buy one."
dialogues.text:
"I said a while ago that I didn't have a present for you...
but actually, I did buy one."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「みんなの前で渡すのは、恥ずかしくてさ」
dialogues.en:
"It would've been too embarassing to give in front of
everyone..."
dialogues.text:
"It would've been too embarassing to give in front of
everyone..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……そう、なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Is... that so?"
dialogues.text: "...Is... that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「俺のは、他のヤツらみたいに、お茶会のプレ
　ゼントじゃない。アリスの恋人としてのプレ
　ゼントだ」
dialogues.en:
"Since my present wasn't one as thanks for an invitation to
a tea party... it's a present of my love to you."
dialogues.text:
"Since my present wasn't one as thanks for an invitation to
a tea party... it's a present of my love to you."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、もぞもぞとポケットを漁り、小さなケー
スを取り出した。
dialogues.en:
I rummaged through my pocket, eventually finding and taking
out a small case.
dialogues.text:
I rummaged through my pocket, eventually finding and taking
out a small case.

dialogues.jp:
「花の形をしたイヤリング。アリスに似合うと
　思って」
dialogues.en:
"It's a flower-shaped earring... I thought it'd look good on
you."
dialogues.text:
"It's a flower-shaped earring... I thought it'd look good on
you."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……これ、私に？」
dialogues.en: "...This is, for me?"
dialogues.text: "...This is, for me?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「もちろん。俺は……アリスの恋人だもの」
dialogues.en: "Of course. I'm... your lover, after all."
dialogues.text: "Of course. I'm... your lover, after all."

dialogues.jp:
差し出したケースの中には、俺が見立てた紫色
の水晶をあしらった花のイヤリングが１組入っ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
Inside the case I presented to her, were a pair of
violet-coloured, crystal, flower-shaped earrings.
dialogues.text:
Inside the case I presented to her, were a pair of
violet-coloured, crystal, flower-shaped earrings.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you..."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you..."

dialogues.jp:
アリスは、イヤリングを手に取り、そっと自分
の耳に付ける。
dialogues.en:
Alice took the earrings out of the box, and attached them to
her ears.
dialogues.text:
Alice took the earrings out of the box, and attached them to
her ears.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……似合いますか？」
dialogues.en: "...How do they look?"
dialogues.text: "...How do they look?"

dialogues.jp: アリスの耳元にキラリとイヤリングが光った。
dialogues.en: Light was shimmering off her earrings.
dialogues.text: Light was shimmering off her earrings.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、……似合うよ」
dialogues.en: "Very good... on you."
dialogues.text: "Very good... on you."

dialogues.jp: アリスは、少し困った顔をして、笑っていた。
dialogues.en: Alice, still slightly nervous, started laughing lightly.
dialogues.text: Alice, still slightly nervous, started laughing lightly.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そんなに苦笑しなくてもいいじゃないか
と尋ねたら、
dialogues.en:
As I was admiring that honest face of hers, she continued
on.
dialogues.text:
As I was admiring that honest face of hers, she continued
on.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「なんて……いえば、自分の気持ちが伝わるか
　なって考えてたら……」
dialogues.en:
"Somehow... I can't find the words to say what I really
feel..."
dialogues.text:
"Somehow... I can't find the words to say what I really
feel..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「なんでもいい。思った通り、言ってくれれば
　いい」
dialogues.en: "That's fine. Sometimes, feelings are better than words."
dialogues.text: "That's fine. Sometimes, feelings are better than words."

dialogues.jp: すると、アリスは、言葉よりも先に、
dialogues.en: Suddenly, putting actions before words, she...
dialogues.text: Suddenly, putting actions before words, she...

dialogues.jp: 俺の唇に、柔らかなものが押し当てられる。
dialogues.en: Soft and tender lips were pushed against mine.
dialogues.text: Soft and tender lips were pushed against mine.

dialogues.jp: 少し濡れてて、あったかくて、ドキドキしてる。
dialogues.en:
My heart started to throb, feeling those slightly wet, yet
warm lips on mine.
dialogues.text:
My heart started to throb, feeling those slightly wet, yet
warm lips on mine.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉先輩、私は朝倉先輩が大好きです」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-senpai, I love you very much."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-senpai, I love you very much."

dialogues.jp: にっこり笑うアリス。
dialogues.en: She said, as she smiled like she never did before.
dialogues.text: She said, as she smiled like she never did before.

dialogues.jp: 「俺も、大好きだよ……」
dialogues.en: "I love you too..."
dialogues.text: "I love you too..."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、今度は俺の方からキスをした。
dialogues.en: As I said that, it was my turn to kiss her.
dialogues.text: As I said that, it was my turn to kiss her.

dialogues.jp: 少しだけ、長い間。
dialogues.en: For what was a short time, yet seemed an eternity.
dialogues.text: For what was a short time, yet seemed an eternity.

dialogues.jp: ◆もう寂しくなんかない◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lonely No More◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lonely No More◆

dialogues.jp: 月城家で開かれたお茶会。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro Mansion opened it's gates for a tea party.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro Mansion opened it's gates for a tea party.

dialogues.jp:
笑顔を取り戻した月城が、美春や、杉並や、眞
子に囲まれている。
dialogues.en:
The once-again smiling Tsukishiro, with Miharu, Suginami and
Mako around her.
dialogues.text:
The once-again smiling Tsukishiro, with Miharu, Suginami and
Mako around her.

dialogues.jp:
美春が、月城にロスキルラベンダーにお願いし
ていた願いとはいったい何だったのかと｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en:
Miharu asked Tsukishiro what she had wished for, to want to
grow the Roskill Lavender so badly.
dialogues.text:
Miharu asked Tsukishiro what she had wished for, to want to
grow the Roskill Lavender so badly.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、言った。友達が欲しかったのだと。たっ
たひとりで寂しい思いをしてきた自分に友達を
くださいと。
dialogues.en:
She finally revealed her secret. She wanted friends. She was
so lonely, that she would do anything for friendship.
dialogues.text:
She finally revealed her secret. She wanted friends. She was
so lonely, that she would do anything for friendship.

dialogues.jp: 月城の願いは、友達が欲しいこと！
dialogues.en: Her only wish was that she wanted to have friends!
dialogues.text: Her only wish was that she wanted to have friends!

dialogues.jp:
なにも、願うコトなんてない。月城の周りには
友達がいっぱいいる。素敵な連中がいっぱいい
るじゃないか。
dialogues.en:
That's not something she needed to wish for. All her friends
were surrounding her, after all, many and wonderful.
dialogues.text:
That's not something she needed to wish for. All her friends
were surrounding her, after all, many and wonderful.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、周りを見回し、あらためて気づくのだっ
た。自分には、もう友達がいたのだと。
dialogues.en:
Looking around her, Tsukishiro finally realized for herself;
she has friends now.
dialogues.text:
Looking around her, Tsukishiro finally realized for herself;
she has friends now.

dialogues.jp:
他の連中が帰った後、俺は、月城の部屋で、み
んなの前では渡せなかったプレゼントを渡した。
dialogues.en:
After the rest had left, I went to Tsukishiro's room, and
gave her the present that I couldn't, in front of everyone
else.
dialogues.text:
After the rest had left, I went to Tsukishiro's room, and
gave her the present that I couldn't, in front of everyone
else.

dialogues.jp: そして、俺と月城はキスを交わした。
dialogues.en: Then, the kissing began.
dialogues.text: Then, the kissing began.
